name: the reason claims nothing else was available while a pin with the ability sits free
find:
return ("needs %s; the cheapest pin that has it, though it also does %s, which is spent here"
                    % (", ".join(sorted(needs)), ", ".join(spare)))
replace:
return ("needs %s; this pin also does %s, which is spent here because nothing else was available"
                    % (", ".join(sorted(needs)), ", ".join(spare)))
